name: commit-message-generator
description: Generate commit messages from staged git diffs using Codex or Claude CLI.

commitMessageGenerator.provider.description: CLI provider used to generate commit messages.

commitMessageGenerator.model.description: Optional model name passed to the selected CLI.

commitMessageGenerator.prompt.default:
Generate a conventional commit message for this staged git diff.

Requirements:
- Use conventional commit format: type(scope?): description
- Be concise
- Infer the most appropriate type
- Output only the commit message

Diff:
{diff}
commitMessageGenerator.prompt.description: Prompt template. Use {diff} where the staged git diff should be inserted.

commitMessageGenerator.maxDiffLines.description: Maximum number of staged diff lines sent to the CLI. Set to 0 to disable truncation.
